title: 2019 Toyota C-HR Panel Repair and Window Replacement
summary: Panel repair and window replacement on a white 2019 Toyota C-HR at Carcis Autobody Repair in Vancouver, Washington.
story: This 2019 Toyota C-HR came to the shop with damage to the passenger rear door area. The side window glass was broken out and covered with temporary cardboard. A distinct dent was visible in the sheet metal directly below the window beltline along the body contour.

Technicians cleared out remaining debris and prepped the door structure. The dented area was pulled and worked back to original shape to align with the door frame lines. Surface body work was completed to restore a smooth contour before applying primer.
A replacement passenger window glass unit was installed into the door channel. The repair area was color matched to the factory white paint, sprayed, and clear coated to restore a seamless finish.
